query:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sessionId) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT appUserId) AS unique_logged_in_users,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT sessionId) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sessionId)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_sessions
FROM visitor_events
WHERE createdAt > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY sessions DESC;
